images.title: One numeral, two numbers
images.purpose: Shows that the marks 2 and 5 with a gap could mean 125 or 7205, because a blank place is easy to miss.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. One numeral at the top centre with two arrows down to two place readings side by side.
images.exact_structure: Top centre: a large dark 2, a wide gap, and a large dark 5, with a grey (#6B7280) question mark in the gap. Two grey arrows go down, one to the left and one to the right. Left reading: two boxes headed 60s and 1s holding 2 and 5 (teal #0072B2), with 125 under them. Right reading: three boxes headed 3600s, 60s and 1s holding 2, an empty box, and 5 (amber #E69F00), with 7205 under them. Exactly 5 boxes. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Without a symbol for the empty place, the same marks can mean different numbers.
images.description: Shows that the marks 2 and 5 with a gap could mean 125 or 7205, because a blank place is easy to miss.

image_decisions.why: Two readings side by side show the ambiguity that led to a placeholder.
